_comment: Talent Loops MCP servers. rippling is live (see its entry). slack and google-calendar remain placeholders in project scope; both are also connected as claude.ai connectors in the user's client, which the agent (not bin/*) can call. doctor reports placeholders as `warn` in fixture mode.

rippling._comment: Rippling first-party remote MCP via MCP Gateway proxy (connected 2026-09-02 as a claude.ai connector; per-user OAuth). Exposes one tool, `code`, over codemode.* functions. Every codemode.* call requires a `telemetry: { intent }` field inside its args. Node-side lib/adapters/rippling/* cannot reach this endpoint directly (the OAuth token lives in the Claude client) — see docs/DECISIONS.md D25.

slack._comment: Placeholder. Rippling exposes no messaging API, so the POC brings Slack's own MCP for nudges and escalations. Until then the fixture channel adapter writes to TL_DATA_DIR/outbox.jsonl. Connect when a tenant exists.

google-calendar._comment: Placeholder. Free/busy is the one availability signal Rippling does not expose; Rippling absence stays authoritative and calendar free/busy is secondary (spec §4). Until then the gcal fixture adapter serves busy blocks. Connect when a tenant exists.
